Class XmlSessionType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlSessionType
public class XmlSessionType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://www.phon.ca/phon-manual/session_editor/session_editor.html">Phon manual section on this topic...</a>

Java class for SessionType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="SessionType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}date" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}languages" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}mediaLocation" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}metadata" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}participants" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}systemTiers" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}userTiers" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tierOrder" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}blindMode" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}transcript"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}intervalTiers" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="name" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}nonemptyStringType" />
       <attribute name="corpus" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}nonemptyStringType" />
       <attribute name="version" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}string" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getLanguages

      public List<String> getLanguages()
       <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://www.phon.ca/phon-manual/session_editor/session_information_view.html">Phon manual section on this topic...</a>
      Gets the value of the languages property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the languages property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getLanguages().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list String
